title: Scheduled Issue execution and observable delivery

requirements.initial: An Issue is due and may fail after dispatch.
requirements.action: Scan again and attempt manual retry.
requirements.expected: An occurrence is claimed once; retry lineage remains authoritative.

evidence.assertion: does not repeat an occurrence after dispatch registered a run that later fails
evidence.scope: Temporary Issue state and controlled dispatch implementation.

evidence.assertion: revalidates retry lineage under the dispatch guard

requirements.gap: Dispatch interruption followed by a real process restart and delivery is not mapped.

requirements.initial: An isolated packaged Workspace has a one-shot Issue.
requirements.action: Dispatch managed Pi through the real scheduling path.
requirements.expected: Structured output and a real CLI-created Issue are observable.

evidence.assertion: scheduled Issue with observable CLI side effect
evidence.scope: Real package/runtime/tool path with deterministic loopback AI; platform-specific receipt.

requirements.gap: The success smoke does not establish timeout/cancel/restart recovery for each runtime.
